# Generated by ppc build from [stored_food] in constructor.toml (stored_food.py); do not edit by hand.

# Province scope. Keeps the province on the Stored Food step of its store: the stored months rounded to the nearest
# whole month (half a month rounds up), re-picked only when the store moved more than half a month + 0.05
# away from the carried step, so a store sitting on a boundary does not flip back and forth. The consumption (a loop
# over the province's locations) is worked out once. A province nobody eats in carries no step.
# pp_stored_food_months keeps the stored months themselves (re-set when they moved by more than 0.05) for
# the AI weights and displays that read pp_location_stored_months; pp_food_store_step keeps the carried step.
# Variables and locals carry + 100 (a variable at 0 counts as unset); `var:x = n` compares scopes, so only < / >
# ranges are used. A province never refreshed starts at 50, below every store, so its first refresh applies;
# 99 marks a province without a step.
# A step change removes only the carried step's modifier; both steps are found by halving the 25 steps.
pp_refresh_stored_food = {
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_consumption value = { value = pp_stored_food_province_consumption add = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_target value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption > 100 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = pp_stored_food_target
			value = {
				value = province_food
				divide = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption subtract = 100 }
				min = 0
				max = { value = define:NEconomy|GROWTH_FROM_FOOD_MULTIPLIER_MAX multiply = 12 }
				add = 100
			}
		}
	}
	# the stored months (AI weights, displays)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_months } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_months value = 50 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_change value = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target subtract = var:pp_stored_food_months add = 100 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				local_var:pp_stored_food_change > 100.05
				local_var:pp_stored_food_change < 99.95
				AND = { local_var:pp_stored_food_target < 100.00001 var:pp_stored_food_months > 100.00001 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_months value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target }
	}
	# the Stored Food step

								}
								else = {

								}
							}
							else = {
